# update-service

OpenShift Update Service serving the mirrored upgrade graph to disconnected clusters

Guide: https://policystk.io/guides/disconnected/#update-service

Stability: preview ([Compatibility](https://policystk.io/reference/compatibility/#element-stability))

```yaml
stack:
  updateService:
    enabled: true
```

## Settings

One UpdateService, update-service, in openshift-update-service with 2 replicas. Copy both values from the updateService.yaml oc-mirror writes to working-dir/cluster-resources with mirror.platform.graph: true. The registry CA is stack.disconnected.config.registryCAs' entry for the releases host.

Under `stack.updateService.config`. Maps merge across layers; lists are replaced whole.

| Key | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `releases` | Mirrored release image repository without tag or digest, spec.releases (mirror.example.com:8443/openshift/release-images) | `''` |
| `graphDataImage` | Graph data image oc-mirror builds, spec.graphDataImage (mirror.example.com:8443/openshift/graph-image:latest) | `''` |

## Operators

Each renders into Policy `install` with `<name>-ns` and `<name>-status`. Pin with `operatorPolicies.<key>.versions` in a layer.

| Operator policy | Package | Channel | Source | Namespace | Versions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `install-update-service` | `cincinnati-operator` | `v1` | `redhat-operators` | `openshift-update-service` | any |

## Policies

`<cluster>` is the ManagedCluster name, or hubName on the hub. `global.remediationAction: inform` overrides every action below.

Standards: NIST SP 800-53. Controls: CM-2 Baseline Configuration. Categories: CM Configuration Management.

### Policy `config`

`config-update-service-<cluster>`: Deploy the UpdateService serving the mirrored upgrade graph. Depends on `install-update-service-<cluster>`.

| Template | Action | Severity | Waits for | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `config-update-service` | enforce | medium | `install-update-service-status`<br>compliant while pending | [update-service](converters/config/update-service.yaml) | Namespace node selector annotation and the UpdateService |

### Policy `install`

`install-update-service-<cluster>`: Install and manage the OpenShift Update Service Operator.

| Template | Action | Severity | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `install-update-service` | enforce | medium | [operator](#operators) `cincinnati-operator` | OpenShift Update Service Operator |

### Policy `ready`

`ready-update-service-<cluster>`: Reports NonCompliant until the update service serves the graph. Depends on `config-update-service-<cluster>`.

| Template | Action | Severity | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ready-update-service` | inform (always) | medium | [update-service](converters/ready/update-service.yaml) | UpdateService reconciled, its Deployment Available and its Route admitted |
